master.definition_en: A digestive system disease characterized by discontinuation in the inner lining of the gastrointestinal (GI) tract because of gastric acid secretion or pepsin.
synonyms_en: acute peptic ulcer with haemorrhage and perforation
acute peptic ulcer without haemorrhage and without perforation

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 慢性黏膜缺损平时表现为上腹痛、反酸，但一旦发生急性上消化道大出血或胃十二指肠穿孔引发弥漫性腹膜炎与失血性/感染性休克，数小时至数日内即可致命。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 幽门螺杆菌（Hp）相关溃疡通过标准四联方案根除Hp及抑酸治疗，绝大多数可临床治愈并显著降低复发；非甾体抗炎药（NSAIDs）相关者停药并予质子泵抑制剂（PPI）或钾离子竞争性酸阻滞剂（P-CAB）可愈合。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GBD 2021估算全球消化性溃疡年死亡约230,217例（较1990年约27.4万例明显下降，年龄标化死亡率下降61.5%）。

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: GBD 2021显示1990–2021年中国消化性溃疡年龄标化死亡率下降73.7%，但55岁以上老年人群绝对负担仍较重；官方死因年报常将其归入消化系统疾病大类，未单列独立年度死亡总数。

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球终生患病率约5%–10%，GBD 2021显示随着Hp根除与抑酸药普及，年龄标化患病率自1990年至2021年下降约41.1%。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国普通人群内镜及流调估计患病率约5%–10%（十二指肠溃疡多于胃溃疡），年龄标化发病率自1990年至2021年下降54.9%，男性与老年人群负担更高。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 120一分钟识别与避坑：若突发呕血（鲜红或咖啡样）、黑便柏油样、头晕冷汗晕厥（急性大出血），或突发剑突下/上腹刀割样剧痛并迅速蔓延全腹、腹肌僵硬如木板（急性穿孔），立即拨打120！严禁进食、喝水、自行服用阿司匹林/布洛芬等止痛药或热敷腹部；立即禁食水、平卧头偏向一侧防误吸，急诊行快速液体复苏、静脉大剂量PPI及急诊内镜止血或外科修补。

non_drug_therapies_zh: 确诊后规范检测幽门螺杆菌（C13/C14呼气试验或胃镜活检），胃溃疡患者愈合后必须复查胃镜排除早期胃癌
严格停用或评估替换阿司匹林、布洛芬等NSAIDs止痛药，戒烟限酒、规律饮食

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 钾离子竞争性酸阻滞剂（P-CAB，如伏诺拉生、替戈拉生、凯普拉生等）在多项III期临床试验中证实其双联或四联方案根除幽门螺杆菌成功率高、受CYP2C19基因多态性影响小；基于耐药基因检测（如23S rRNA突变）的个体化精准Hp根除方案正显著降低耐药复发率。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 克拉霉素与左氧氟沙星耐药率攀升导致传统经验性Hp根除失败率升高; 2) 心脑血管病患者长期联用抗血小板/NSAIDs药物时的无症状隐匿性出血与穿孔风险仍难完全消除; 3) 老年高龄合并症患者的急性大出血病死率依然较高。

master.definition_en: Adult-onset citrullinemia type II is an inherited disorder that causes ammonia and other toxic substances to accumulate in the blood. The condition chiefly affects the nervous system, causing confusion, restlessness, memory loss, abnormal behaviors (such as aggression, irritability, and hyperactivity), seizures, and coma. These signs and symptoms can be life-threatening. The signs and symptoms appear during adulthood and are triggered by certain medications, infections, surgery, and alcohol intake.The features of adult-onset type II citrullinemia may also develop in people who as infants had a liver disorder called neonatal intrahepatic cholestasis caused by citrin deficiency (NICCD). In many cases, the signs and symptoms of NICCD resolve within a year. Years or even decades later, however, some of these people develop the characteristic features of adult-onset type II citrullinemia.adult-onset citrullinemia type II is caused by mutations in the SLC25A13 gene. This condition is inherited in an autosomal recessive pattern.

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。

breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 高致死实体瘤微环境破壁与普惠早筛

master.definition_en: Hypertrophic or verrucous lupus erythematosus is a rare type of chronic cutaneous lupus erythematosus characterized by the appearance of lesions on sun-exposed areas (frequently the extensor surfaces of forearms, face, upper trunk) which vary from squamous violet, painful papules and blackish hyperkeratotic ulcers to depigmented atrophic plaques on the back, hyperkeratotic papules on upper extremities, and disseminated keratoacanthoma-like papulonodular verrucous lesions. Classic discoid lesions and squamous cell carcinoma may be associated. Histopathology reveals follicular plugging, liquefactive basal layer degeneration and a perivascular lymphocytic infiltrate.

master.definition_en: Heavy metal poisoning refers to when excessive exposure to a heavy metal affects the normal function of the body. Examples of heavy metals that can cause toxicity include lead, mercury, arsenic, cadmium, and chromium. Exposure may occur through the diet, from medications, from the environment, or in the course of work or play. Heavy metals can enter the body through the skin, or by inhalation or ingestion. Toxicity can result from sudden, severe exposure, or from chronic exposure over time. Symptoms can vary depending on the metal involved, the amount absorbed, and the age of the person exposed. For example, young children are more susceptible to the effects of lead exposure because they absorb more compared with adults and their brains are still developing. Nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain are common symptoms of acute metal ingestion. Chronic exposure may cause various symptoms resulting from damage to body organs, and may increase the risk of cancer. Treatment depends on the circumstances of the exposure.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。
